title: Mercedes-Benz Parts Telesales Advisor
description:
About the role

Sytner Group is looking for a motivated and committed Parts Telesales Advisor to join our team at Sytner Trade Parts Centre.

As a Sytner Parts Telesales Advisor, you will demonstrate a 'One Team' approach, and communicate effectively with both internal and external customers/suppliers (Inbound and outbound). You will ensure that all requests are dealt with promptly, and support and assist colleagues and customers with parts identification, searching and sourcing.

The successful candidate will have a proven track record within the motor industry in regards to parts knowledge and customer service skills.

Sytner Parts Advisors work a variety of flexible patterns which can typically include weekends to ensure we provide our customers with the highest possible levels of service.

About you

Ideally, you will have experience in a similar role within the motor industry and be IT literate.

High levels of organisation and attention to detail are required for this role. Fantastic communication skills and customer-facing experience are essential as you will be talking to customers both face to face and over the phone.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about delivering excellent customer service and has the ability to give the best advice on our products and services to our customers.

Why Sytner?

Sytner Group are delighted to provide an industry-leading benefits package.

We are passionate about continuous improvement and building an environment where everyone feels valued, appreciated and able to reach their full potential.
- Enhanced Holiday Entitlement - 33 days inc. bank holidays
- Industry-leading Maternity, Paternity and Adoption Pay
- Career Development
- Recognition of Long Service every 5 years
- Discounted Car Schemes
- High Street Discounts
- Discounted Gym memberships
- Cycle to work scheme
- One day a year paid voluntary / community work

At Sytner, our values and the way we behave are important to us. We are committed to creating an equitable working environment where we value and respect every individual's unique contribution, supporting our colleagues to thrive and achieve their full potential.

As part of our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion, you have the right to ask for changes / adjustments to job interviews and the recruitment process. For more information around reasonable adjustments and the recruitment process please .

Unsure? Read on

We represent over 23 of the world's most prestige vehicle brands, across our 140 UK dealerships.

We pride ourselves on 'Developing Talent and 'Building Careers' and our colleagues recently scored Sytner Group an outstanding 89% on our colleague engagement survey.

title: Personal Lines Sales Executive
description:
Personal Lines Sales Executive
Tolworth £26,500-£28,500 basic + bonus potential taking earnings to £40,000 + £2,300 annual Saturday allowance
Hybrid working: one week in the office, followed by three weeks from home after initial training

Have experience selling car or van insurance and want a role where you can earn more, enjoy greater flexibility and develop your insurance career?

CKB Recruitment is working with an established insurance intermediary to recruit a Personal Lines Sales Executive for its growing Tolworth team.

With over 40 years' experience in the insurance market, this business offers the support of an experienced team, funding for professional qualifications and a generous commission scheme. There's also free on-site parking and a free staff gym.

The opportunity

You'll handle inbound enquiries from new and existing customers looking for motor and home insurance, helping them find suitable cover and turning enquiries into sales.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Speaking with customers to understand their insurance requirements.
- Providing quotations and arranging suitable car, van and home insurance.
- Converting inbound enquiries into sales while delivering a professional, helpful service.
- Liaising with insurers where required.
- Maintaining accurate customer records and completing supporting administration.

What we're looking for

You'll need previous personal lines insurance sales experience, particularly in car and van insurance. Home insurance knowledge would also be useful.

You'll be confident speaking with customers, motivated by sales and committed to providing a high standard of service. A professional approach and the drive to develop your career will be key.

If you're already working towards your CII qualification, that's a bonus-but it isn't essential. The business can help fund your professional studies.

Salary, benefits and working pattern
- £26,500-£28,500 basic salary, depending on experience.
- Commission/bonus potential taking earnings to £40,000.
- An additional £2,300 per year for working alternate Saturdays.
- One week in the office followed by three weeks working from home.
- Support with professional qualifications.
- Free on-site staff gym and parking.

The office is on Hook Rise South, Tolworth, beside the A3. Your first three months will be fully office-based for training, before moving to the hybrid pattern.

Working hours are Monday to Friday, 9am-6pm, plus alternate Saturdays, 9am-4.30pm.

To find out more, apply today or contact Lesley Bordon at CKB Recruitment - General Insurance & Financial Services Recruitment for a confidential conversation.

title: Sales Executive (Industrial Plastics)
company: Ernest Gordon Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Sales Executive (Industrial Plastics)

£35,000 - £40,000 + Uncapped Commission (£50-£60k OTE) + Car Allowance / Company Car + Training + Progression + Autonomy + Company Benefits

South East (Field-Based)

Are you a Sales Executive with a background in industrial plastics or similar, looking to join an established international manufacturer offering strong earning potential and long-term progression?

You will be responsible for developing new business and managing existing accounts across a range of industrial sectors, providing tailored polyurethane and engineering plastics solutions to customers operating within recycling, quarrying, mining, bulk handling and manufacturing environments.

The company is a respected international manufacturer specialising in advanced polyurethane and engineering plastic products. With continued growth across the UK market, they offer a stable platform, technical development and excellent earning potential.

This role would suit a Sales Engineer with experience in industrial products or solutions, looking to maximise earnings and take ownership of their territory.

The Role:
Develop new business and manage existing customer accounts across the UK
Provide technical sales support for industrial plastics and polyurethane solutions
Prepare quotations, proposals and commercially aligned solutions based on customer requirements
Conduct site visits, product demonstrations and customer meetings
Work closely with internal technical and production teams to support projects and customer delivery
Support exhibitions, trade shows and industry events

The Person:
Experience in technical sales, field sales or applications engineering
Background in industrial plastics, polyurethane products, or engineering
Full UK driving licence

If you are interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV.

Reference Number: BBBH25371i

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitable candidates. The salary advertised is a guideline for this position. The offered remuneration will be dependent on the extent of your experience, qualifications, and skill set.

title: Senior Business Development Executive
description:
A leading international professional services firm is seeking a Senior Business Development Executive to support growth within its Life Sciences & Healthcare sector on a 15-month fixed-term contract. Based in Bristol or London, with hybrid working.

The role will partner closely with senior lawyers and marketing colleagues to drive client development, new business, cross-selling and sector profile. Responsibilities include:
- Managing business development initiatives, pipelines, budgets and performance reporting.
- Supporting key client accounts, including client mapping and relationship plans.
- Taking ownership of a key client relationship and supporting wider account activity.
- Delivering targeted events, campaigns and follow-up activity with a focus on ROI.
- Producing and repurposing marketing and communications content across multiple channels.
- Managing pitches, credentials, legal directory and award submissions.
- Using revenue, margin and campaign data to identify opportunities and improve performance.
- Supervising junior team members on selected projects.

The successful candidate will bring proven business development or marketing experience within Life Sciences & Healthcare, ideally gained in legal or professional services. They will be highly organised, commercially minded and confident working with senior stakeholders.

Strong project management, communication and analytical skills are essential, alongside experience of CRM systems and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. A proactive, creative and client-focused approach, combined with curiosity about the sector and an ability to spot commercial opportunities, will be key to success.

If this job isn't quite right for you, but you know someone who would be great at this role, why not take advantage of our referral scheme? We offer £200 in shopping vouchers for every referred candidate who we place in a role. Terms & Conditions Apply.

title: Account Executive
description:
Job Title: New Business Account Executive

Industry: Insurance

Class of Business: Professional Indemnity - Construction Property (Contractors, Surveyors, Architects, Engineers)

Overview:

As a New Business Account Executive, you will proactively engage with mid-market and SME businesses across the UK, with a particular focus on clients within the construction and property professional services sector. This includes organisations such as surveyors, architects, design and planning consultancies, and engineering firms across all disciplines. You will help clients understand how you / our client can support their insurance needs, gaining valuable experience in identifying risk exposures, discussing tailored insurance solutions, and promoting end-to-end service-from initial consultation through to long-term partnership.

Your role will be central to expanding our clients client base and supporting our mission to deliver exceptional, specialist-led insurance solutions. Whether you are advising a local professional practice or supporting the placement of more complex programmes for growing and internationally active firms, your contribution will play a key role in driving continued growth.

Responsibilities:

Proactively contact prospective clients to introduce, gather relevant insurance information, and support negotiations with both clients and insurers.

Identify, research, and develop new sources of prospective clients to help expand presence and market reach.

Work closely with brokers and account handlers to support the onboarding and development of potential new clients.

Accurately maintain client and prospect records on our CRM systems, ensuring all information is recorded promptly and kept up to date in line with company standards.

Build a strong foundation of Professional Indemnity Insurance knowledge, including working towards and achieving CII insurance qualifications.

Actively participate in structured training and development programmes focused on building the core skills required for success in the role.

Contribute as part of a fast-paced, collaborative, and continually evolving environment, with significant opportunities for learning and professional growth.

Requirements:

Previous experience within the insurance market and sales.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Our clients team thrives on effective communication and the ability to work together towards common goals.

Sales and negotiation skills that will help you compete in a fast-paced market.

Strong motivation and ambition in progressing your career in insurance.

An eye for detail to ensure that all records and client interactions are meticulously managed and maintained.

title: Junior Account Manager
description:
Junior Account Manager Fashion London

Ready to take the next step in your fashion career? A fantastic opportunity has just opened up with a successful, fast-paced and hugely dynamic fashion business in London.

This is a newly created role for an ambitious Junior Account Manager who is keen to build on their existing account management experience, get closer to some of the biggest names in fashion, and really make their mark.

This is not a role where you'll be sitting on the sidelines. You'll be hands-on from day one, working closely with an exciting portfolio of fashion customers and getting genuine exposure across the full account management process.

Key Responsibilities:
- Manage and support a portfolio of key fashion accounts, building strong and trusted customer relationships
- Work closely with customers on new product developments, from initial concepts through to samples and production
- Coordinate samples, approvals, orders and deliveries, ensuring key deadlines are met
- Liaise closely with internal teams, factories and suppliers to keep projects moving smoothly
- Track critical path dates, customer requirements and account activity, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks
- Support the wider Account Management team with day-to-day account administration and reporting
- Prepare and maintain accurate sales and account information, using Excel and other Microsoft Office systems
- Identify opportunities to support account growth and develop customer relationships
- Take ownership of tasks and accounts while working collaboratively with a highly supportive team
- Gain hands-on exposure to the full account management process and develop commercially as you progress

About You
- Previous experience within account management, sales or a similar fashion environment
- Ambitious, driven and keen to build a long-term career within the fashion industry
- Confident but curious - happy to take ownership while always wanting to learn more
- Naturally proactive and a real self-starter
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills
- Commercially aware with a genuine interest in fashion and product
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel
- Positive, energetic and solutions-focused
- A team player who enjoys working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment

title: Sales Account Executive, International Relocation
company: Alchemy Global Talent Solutions - Agency - Permanent
description:
Our client a leading relocation services provider is seeking an experienced Sales Executive to join their private/consumer moving team.

In this role you will be responsible for:

Prospecting for new business opportunities.

Handling sales enquiries include web leads, email leads, lead generators, phone enquiries, employee recommendations as well as self-generated leads from exhibitions and other trade events.

Converting leads into tangible business. Limited to UK USA and Nordic markets.

Building and developing strong client relationships.

Liaising with customers to collect information regarding moves.

Conducting virtual surveys or booking in a surveyor to visit the customer.

Synthesising information from customer and producing detailed and accurate quotations.

Following up on quotations and booking follow up appointments.

Negotiating with the customer, closing quotations and booking the move.

Updating internal CRM system and progressing the sales leads on the system.

Conduct follow up calls to customers following moves

Ensure high level customer service is provided, and the customer understands the move process and custom formalities.

Achieve a personal annual sales target

Attend resident quality checks when required.

Work closely with all company departments including sales & marketing & operations teams.

Experience and skills required:

A background within International moving or relocation services is desirable.

Confident with excellent communication skills

Client services, account management and business development experience is essential for this role.

Experience with virtual surveys is highly desirable.
